name: thinkrail
description: Vibe code with pi in a lightweight, real IDE that customises itself around the way you work — The Vibe You Need
one_liner: An experimental code editor from JetBrains that remembers how your project works over time and gets better at helping you the more you use it.
buyer: A software team lead evaluating next-generation AI coding tools for their engineering org, looking for something that retains project context instead of starting fresh every session.
business_use_cases: An engineering team adopts it to reduce the time developers spend re-explaining project context to AI assistants on every task.
A consulting shop that does a lot of client codebase work uses its 'living specs' feature to onboard faster onto unfamiliar projects.
A tooling vendor studies its approach to durable AI memory to inform their own internal developer tools.

money_ideas.idea: Offer consulting/training to engineering teams on setting up living specs and workspace structure for their specific codebase.

steal_this: There's little independent business to build here this weekend — it's JetBrains' own incubator product; worth trying on a real project, not building a business around.
